chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
“The first thing with which the believer is gifted in his grave is that those who followed his funeral are forgiven.”
ai.seo_question: What is the first gift given to a believer in the grave according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that one of the earliest honors granted to the believer after burial is the forgiveness bestowed upon those who accompanied his funeral procession. It highlights the spiritual merit connected to attending the janazah and points to the believer's blessed state in the grave.
